references.text: Eleazar the priest gives instructions to the soldiers based on the law that the Lord had commanded Moses, showing the same obedience to God's commands.
The Lord speaks to Moses about how the plunder should be distributed, which is the direct command that Moses and Eleazar obey in verse 31.
A similar expression is used to say that the work was done as the Lord had commanded Moses, showing the pattern of obedience to God's commands.
The Israelites did all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses, a recurring theme of faithful obedience to God's instructions.
Moses did as the Lord commanded him regarding Joshua, showing the same pattern of obedience to the Lord's commands.
Moses laid his hands on Joshua as the Lord had commanded, showing continuity in obedience to God's commands.
